_comment: AgentGuard configuration file (.agentguardrc.json) - Defines policy thresholds, rule exclusions, and custom regex rules.
_failOn_comment: Minimum severity to exit with code 1 or block in middleware: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'. Default is 'low'.
_disable_comment: List of built-in rule IDs to skip during auditing. For example: PII005 (international phone numbers) and SEC009 (heuristic high-entropy strings) are disabled here to avoid false positives in customer contact and encrypted payload workflows.
